title: What AI VScode like platform to use for trading?
author: QuantQuestions101
selftext:
I’ve been looking at low-code trading tools like Bactrex and WealthLab, but they feel a bit limited for what I want to do. Are there better platforms out there to start with for backtesting?

Also wondering about tools with AI integrated. Has anything come close to a VSCode-style trading setup with LLM and backtesting built in?

comments.author: The_AI_Trader
comments.body: With forward testing look into SkyAnalyst AI. AI Trading Agents.

comments.author: csirkepulyka1990
comments.body:
Just use BacktestLoop. You can just enter your strategy with plain English and it creates and backtests the strategy for you. It also calculates all the fees. You can even implement a strategy with it from a Youtube video that demonstrates the strategy (BacktestLoop can watch the YouTube video and implement / backtest the strategy directly. I think this will be huge soon as people will use it to expose fake YouTube gurus with it)
I think they will soon have a VSCode extension too
But if you want to use it in VSCode you can just connect BacktestLoop to Claude Code via their MCP server
